leonardo-da-vinci.name: Leonardo da Vinci School
leonardo-da-vinci.short: A private school in central Braga: pre-school, primary and the first two lower-secondary years
leonardo-da-vinci.long: Colégio Leonardo da Vinci opened in 1988. It is a private school with a pre-school, a primary school and the 5th and 6th years. The main building stands at Rua Conselheiro Bento Miguel 10. A second building with a large plot, at Rua de Santa Margarida 75, was opened for the 5th and 6th years. The Sá de Miranda secondary school is next door.
leonardo-da-vinci.history:
Colégio Leonardo da Vinci was founded in 1988 in the centre of Braga, beside the Sá de Miranda secondary school. It received its definitive licence to operate, no. 259, on 11 June 1990. The owner is the company Pro-Educação, Educação Sociedade Lda. The school takes children of any faith, outlook or social background, as far as it has room.

The school grew across two addresses. The main building stands at Rua Conselheiro Bento Miguel 10. The second building, the “polo”, stands at Rua de Santa Margarida 75. In the school’s photo it is a three-storey house with five windows across its front; behind it lies a plot with a garden.

Today the school has a pre-school, a primary school (years 1 to 4) and the 5th and 6th years. For pre-school it signs development contracts with the Ministry of Education; for the primary years and the 5th and 6th years it signs simple contracts. On its website the school calls the 5th and 6th years its newest stage and describes new premises: about 5,000 m² of fenced land with green spaces, and a hall for 250 people.

The school sees its task as more than teaching facts. It wants to raise independent children who can learn, communicate and choose with conscience. Opening hours are 07:45 to 19:00.

leonardo-da-vinci.tip: This is a working private school, so please do not enter uninvited. You can see the main building from Rua Conselheiro Bento Miguel, a few minutes’ walk from Praça da República. The Sá de Miranda secondary school and Colégio Dom Diogo de Sousa are close by.
